---
title: Plain pages load fast
description: Most of a typical page's weight is CSS and JavaScript that the text doesn't need.
author: Ada Example
date: 2026-11-20
categories: [web, news]
image: thumbnail.svg
---

A page of text needs very little to look good: a sensible font stack, a comfortable line length, enough spacing, and colours with good contrast.

> Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
>
> --- Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
